newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Exxon raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Exxon raised to outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst William Randol on Tuesday raised his rating for Exxon Corp to outperform from neutral.
-- "Exxon's large and diverse earnings base ... has stood it in good stead in times of weak commodity prices or depressed refining and/or chemical margins," Randol wrote in a report.
-- "However, its sheer size has become an obstacle to superior earnings growth in its industry relative to smaller companies ...."
-- Shares in the oil company opened up 5/8 at 105-1/8.
